_: (curriculum-sales-kit) The units of four curricula, quoted from their primary documents, and what IntMap can open for each. Read by scripts/curriculum-kit.mjs (the unit map page curriculum.html and ja/curriculum.html, written by scripts/org-pages.mjs) and held by tests/curriculum-sales-kit-checks.test.mjs. `label` is the document's own wording, character for character (read from the file whose sha256 is in gov.upstreams); `gloss` is IntMap's translation into the other page language, not an official one. `basis` is the phrase of the document that a unit's maps answer to, quoted the same way. `maps` names an example of js/showcase.js (`example`) or states a map as an intent (view and data layers, no date) that scripts/curriculum-kit.mjs writes into a link with the app's own codec (js/map-state.js encode); every layer id must be a share-carried data layer of js/layer-manifest.js and every example and tour id must exist (the checks ask the registries). A unit with no maps, no tour and no quest is shown as not covered yet: that is the honest answer and the list the next product work starts from (dev-notes/2026-10-07-curriculum-sales-kit.md). Historical units are answered ONLY by examples and tours whose claims are already checked against the record (js/showcase.js drawn, js/tours.js drawn); no new dated map is stated here (.agents/rules/historical-verification.md).
